description: The agent must: (1) Parse the messy subscribers_raw.csv (~1720 records with mixed date formats and dirty data), compute correct rates for bounce (~5.49%), unsubscribe (~1.1%), spam complaints (~0.3%), opens (~24%), and clicks (~3.7%), then classify each against SKILL.md thresholds — bounce and unsubscribe should be CRITICAL, spam complaints WARNING/CRITICAL. (2) Apply SKILL.md's minimum viable segments: new subscribers (subscribed ≤7 days, ~80 records), engaged (opened within 30 days, ~405), unengaged/sunset candidates (no open in >90 days, ~572), customers (is_customer=true), and VIP (highest engagement — customers who opened/clicked recently). (3) Design a 5-7 email welcome sequence with the exact SKILL.md day schedule (Day 0/immediate, 1, 3, 5, 7, 10, 14), each with a subject line of 40-50 characters, and no spam trigger words (FREE, ALL CAPS, excessive punctuation). The proprietary traps are: the exact numeric thresholds for each metric health status; the precise day-spacing (0,1,3,5,7,10,14 — not evenly spaced); the 40-50 character subject line rule; and the VIP segment definition as a distinct fifth segment beyond the four minimum viable ones.
